newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Farmers Bank in Burmese venture.
newsitem.headline: Thai Farmers Bank in Burmese venture.

text.p: Thai Farmers Bank Plc plans to launch a joint venture bank in Burma in six months as part of its regional expansion, making it the second Thai bank to do business in Burma, a bank spokeswoman said on Monday.
She said Thai Farmers will hold a 60 percent stake in the venture initially capitalised at $10 million, with the rest owned by Rangoon-based Asia Wealth Bank.
Thai Farmers and Asia Wealth signed a memorandum of understanding last June and the Bank of Thailand approved it in August.
"The final Burmese approval is expected within the next six months," she said.
Siam City Bank Plc in May teamed up with Myanmar May Flower Bank in a separate joint venture bank in Burma.
Siam City holds a 70 percent interest in the venture's $10 million capital and Myanmar May Flower owns the rest.
